slugPolicy: Slug is globally unique. slugIntent is a hint used on the first successful turn. A colliding slugIntent fails that turn with duplicate_slug and must not leave a page row. Omit slugIntent to use the session id as the slug. A new explicit session is allowed to create a new page with a unique slug.
exactlyOnce: Exactly-once applies to the page effect, not to a live model invocation. The key is request-scoped to the session (Idempotency-Key or requestId) plus the payload hash of content+tools. Repeat same key+payload returns the same run/page/revision. Same key different payload returns 409 and writes no extra rows. A durable pending run is recovered after restart; it cannot stay stuck or mint a second page.
